Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner implicitly accepted a misleading search blurb suggesting the Canberra was deployed during WWII and anchored the investigation on that aircraft instead of first validating the premise against the WWII timeline. This led to fixation on the Canberra and a premature wrap-up that failed to directly answer the question with the correct definitive response (“none”), reflecting misinterpretation and inadequate reconciliation of the timeline mismatch (Canberra entered service in 1951, post-WWII).
